matching: Hungarian maximum sum actual affine polygon IoU; dummy unmatched allowed; retain IoU>=0.01
aggregation: choose one candidate by max ordinary-DS fire mass, ties minimum present confidence then earlier candidate; same candidate for all ablations; no cross-target DS
binary: pignistic P(F)=mF+0.5*mU >0.5; exact tie forced nofire and separately abstain
abstention: mF>=0.8 fire else mN>=0.8 nofire else uncertain; additionally report 0.95
temperature_policy: unit unverified: neutral multiplier 1 in primary; calibrated unit/center/scale required to enable bounded 0.5+0.5*sigmoid((T-center)/scale); controlled legacy-thermal ablation uses documented original T0=50 formula only, not physical calibration
